title: journalism homepage curation (spatial placement) -- STORY-GROUPED, REBUILT A bank (rubrics_v2, 29 criteria)

dense_alignment_gate.note: preds_{split}.csv carries no id column; the positional join to split/{split}.csv is admissible only because group and judgement sequences match row-for-row in every seed. Asserted, not assumed.

historic_do_not_conflate.why: a provisional snapshot-grouped sweep on an older 4,400-row split with a 70B-judged A side. Real, but a different split over a different row set; never averaged or differenced with this T.

POOLED_CONTEXT_ONLY.warning: NOT a same-rows quantity. The press cell retracted a +.0486 computed exactly this way. Context only.

group_bootstrap_delta_interact.note: GROUP-level paired bootstrap over snapshots (FREEZE CHANGE 3), linear vs GBM seed 0.

A_mask_only.note: block is empty -- no mask column has variance

applicability_mask_ablation.verdict_no_mask: The v2 prompt reserves NA for empty input, so no applicability bit has variance and the genre-detector channel the press cell found is CLOSED BY CONSTRUCTION on this cell. The diagnosis is therefore carried by the story-type-stratified readout below, which measures the same worry (is the bank separating story types rather than ranking within them?) without relying on the missingness pattern.

story_type_stratified.assignment: deterministic keyword map over the HEADLINE only (label-blind, no judge, first-match-wins); coarse by design -- it exists to stratify, not to classify
story_type_stratified.interpretation_rule: pooled minus stratified is the part of the readout that comes from separating story TYPES rather than ranking headlines WITHIN a type. A bank designed to rank within story-type should lose little. Per feedback_threshold_free_readouts and the mention-AUC stratified rule, the stratified number is the honest one.

assembled_order_gate.note: Headline AUCs recomputed from id-keyed OOF vectors after an independent re-assembly and a random row permutation.

secondary_grouping.caveat: outlet-grouped CV at k=8 is the design the registry retired as unpowered; descriptive only

weak_instrument_flag: y is homepage spatial placement, jointly determined with layout/ad/image constraints; outlet identity alone predicts it strongly. Every number from this cell carries this flag.

prior_instrument_context_only.note: the census bank is a DIFFERENT instrument (14 topic/entity criteria, NA=wrong-section prompt) on a DIFFERENT grouping (outlet-held-out). Its numbers are context only and are never differenced against these.

protocol_notes: FIRST-FIT cell for this bank: no prior V+A stack of this construction exists, so the linear leg is the first fit; the assembled-order gate stands in for a reproduction gate (cw_expert precedent).
VA_nl / V_nl = mean over GBM seeds {0,1,2} (FREEZE CHANGE 1); read Delta_interact only against seed_spread_range.

Delta_beyond is SAME-ROWS: the OOF vector is restricted BY ROW ID to the dense arm's held-out rows before differencing (FREEZE CHANGE 2, enforced not asserted). The pooled figure is carried only under POOLED_CONTEXT_ONLY.
Delta_interact CI is a GROUP-level bootstrap over snapshots (FREEZE CHANGE 3).
Every number carries the weak-instrument flag: y is spatial placement.
